derivedBy: hand, from the stated dimensions in bookcase.design.md; never regenerated from napkin's output

overall.derivation: The extreme corners of every box, worked out in inches then x1024.

boxes.name: Side, left
boxes.derivation: Stands on the floor at the west end: 3/4" thick across X, 11 1/4" deep up Y, 36" tall (its depth). Occupies x 0..3/4, y 0..11 1/4, z 0..36.

boxes.name: Side, right
boxes.derivation: The east end, its outer face at 30": 30 - 3/4 = 29 1/4" is its west face. Occupies x 29 1/4..30, y 0..11 1/4, z 0..36.

boxes.name: Cap, bottom
boxes.derivation: Lies flat between the sides at the floor: 30 - 2 x 3/4 = 28 1/2" long across X, 11 1/4" up Y, 3/4" thick. Occupies x 3/4..29 1/4, y 0..11 1/4, z 0..3/4.

boxes.name: Cap, top
boxes.derivation: The same board flush with the sides' tops: its underside at 36 - 3/4 = 35 1/4". Occupies z 35 1/4..36.

boxes.name: Shelf, lower
boxes.derivation: Set back 3/4" from the front (y = 3/4) so its back edge meets the back panel at 11 1/4": 11 1/4 - 3/4 = 10 1/2" deep. 28 1/2" long, 3/4" thick, its underside at 12". Occupies z 12..12 3/4.

boxes.name: Shelf, upper
boxes.derivation: The same shelf with its underside at 24". Occupies z 24..24 3/4.

boxes.name: Back
boxes.derivation: A 1/4" panel across the whole back: 30" wide across X, 1/4" thick up Y, 36" tall (its depth, so its length). Behind the carcass at y 11 1/4..11 1/2.

cutList.label: Back
cutList.derivation: Stands up, so the plan holds its width (across X = 30" = 30720) and its thickness (up Y = 1/4" = 256); its length is its depth, 36" = 36864. Largest by length (36"), and among the two 36" rows the wider one (30" against 11 1/4") comes first.

cutList.label: Side
cutList.derivation: Stands up: the plan holds thickness (across X, 3/4" = 768) and width (up Y, 11 1/4" = 11520); length is the depth, 36" = 36864. Two boxes, one row of 2. Label: "Side, left" and "Side, right" share "Side, ", cut back to the last word boundary and stripped of its comma -> "Side".

cutList.label: Cap
cutList.derivation: Lies flat: length across X = 28 1/2" = 29184 (28.5 x 1024), width up Y = 11 1/4" = 11520, thickness its depth, 3/4" = 768. Two boxes, one row of 2. Label: "Cap, bottom" and "Cap, top" share "Cap, " -> "Cap". Ordered after the 36" rows, and before the shelves because 11 1/4" is wider than 10 1/2".

cutList.label: Shelf
cutList.derivation: Lies flat: length 28 1/2" = 29184, width 10 1/2" = 10752, thickness 3/4" = 768. It is not the same row as the caps: the width differs by 3/4". Label: "Shelf, lower" and "Shelf, upper" share "Shelf, " -> "Shelf".
